title: DRAFT graph-recurrent network infers dynamic gene regulatory networks and flags Mondo
summary: DRAFT recovered interactions supported by independent ChIP-seq, perturbation and Hi-C data in mouse reprogramming and Drosophila spermatogenesis, and identified the candidate early germline regulator Mondo. Germline-specific Mondo knockdown altered germline stem cell number and expression of the predicted targets kuz and mamo. Benchmarks were partly simulated, effect sizes are not in the abstract, and this is a preprint.
ai_technology: DRAFT deep learning framework combining graph attention with recurrent temporal memory to infer dynamic gene regulatory networks from single-cell multi-omics

evidence.tested: In vivo germline-specific Mondo knockdown in Drosophila changed stem cell number and predicted target expression.
evidence.unknown: Effect sizes; preprint; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Graph attention with recurrent memory deep learning for dynamic regulatory network inference
